text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Early morning on the day of the Sprinters Stakes.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Trainer.
I'm... going to go for a short walk outside.
choice_data_list: Hm? Don't go too far, you hear?
Hm? Don't go too far, okay?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I'll be right back.
—Off I go.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: (...The air is so clean.)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Phew...—

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
(I've built it up. Layer upon layer. Everything is in place.
Finally, today is the day—)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: (Today is the day to reach a true pinnacle of refinement.)

text_block_list.name: Young Believe
text_block_list.text: Grandpa... Are you going to be out late tonight too?

text_block_list.name: Believe's Grandfather
text_block_list.text: Yeah. Go back to sleep.

text_block_list.name: Young Believe
text_block_list.text:
"...You were late yesterday too, weren't you?
Yesterday, the day before, and the day before that."

text_block_list.name: Young Believe
text_block_list.text:
Isn't it hard...?
Don't you get tired...?

text_block_list.name: Believe's Grandfather
text_block_list.text:
"Who knows.
Haven't thought about it."

text_block_list.name: Young Believe
text_block_list.text:
Is that... so...?
Then... what are you thinking about?

text_block_list.name: Believe's Grandfather
text_block_list.text: About work.

text_block_list.name: Believe's Grandfather
text_block_list.text:
How far I push through today.
How far I push through tomorrow.
How I see it through until the very end.

text_block_list.name: Believe's Grandfather
text_block_list.text: —All I'm thinking about is my job.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: (Back then, Grandpa took on a job for the master of a historic, traditional ryotei restaurant.)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
(They asked me to repaint the plaster wall
at the front entrance—the 'face' of the building—
because it had grown old and weathered.)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: (A job that usually takes a few people, Grandpa finished all on his own. He said it was because they trusted his skill enough to leave it to him.)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
(Working late for months and months.
Repairing, base coat, intermediate coat,
top coat—)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
(The polished finish is the most critical part.
You rub and rub the half-dry plaster with the trowel,
bringing out a glossy shine on the white plaster wall.)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: (A beautiful, mirror-like polished finish is one of a plasterer's highest arts.)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
(And that is precisely why, to achieve it,
not a single compromise can be allowed.)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
(Powerfully. Precisely.
And above all else—)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: (Fast.)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: (Fast.)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: (—Faster!)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: (And the work that Grandpa accomplished that way was...)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
(Even now, always. It quietly, warmly
welcomes everyone who visits the restaurant.)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
...Grandpa.
Today is my... our day to go to work.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
I will see it through.
I'll prove that I can do it... without fail.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: (Come to think of it... after that job, if I remember correctly—)

text_block_list.name: Believe's Grandmother
text_block_list.text:
Now... old man.
Thank you for your hard work this time, too.

text_block_list.name: Believe's Grandmother
text_block_list.text:
Well then. —I have your usual post-work
treat all ready for you.

text_block_list.name: Believe's Grandmother
text_block_list.text:
Come on, Believe, you too. Over here.
It's yummy, yummy—

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: —...I see.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: You're right, yeah—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Reuniting with Believe after her walk, we leave the inn. Our destination: Nakayama Racecourse, home of the Sprinters Stakes—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...Or rather.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Uwoooh, the excitement is insane...!!
They're really holding it here at Niigata Racecourse...
The 'Sprinters Stakes'!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Right?! It looks totally different from the usual Nakayama Racecourse...
Whoa, I wonder what kind of race it'll turn out to be~!!

text_block_list.name: Racing Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Wait, no, this is completely different from what I'm used to...!!
I knew it would be, but still~...!!

text_block_list.name: Racing Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
The course shape is totally different!
It's counterclockwise, not clockwise!
And the elevation changes aren't even close...!!

text_block_list.name: Assigned Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Come on, calm down!
You've prepared properly ever since the change of venue
was announced, right? Remember that!

text_block_list.name: Assigned Trainer
text_block_list.text: If anything, there's less to think about here than on the Nakayama course, you know? There aren't any notable hills, so formulating a strategy is super simple.

text_block_list.name: Racing Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
“B-But... that just means there's no room for luck,
and it turns into a pure contest of raw ability, doesn't it~?!”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Due to unforeseen circumstances, the venue for this year's Sprinters Stakes was changed. The chosen battleground was Niigata Racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Naturally, it handles differently from Nakayama Racecourse.
The competing Umamusume seemed
more than a little nervous about that fact, but—

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Sorry to keep you waiting.
Everything is ready.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: I can head to the paddock.
choice_data_list: Yeah. ...Alright, you're calm and composed, Believe.
Yeah. ...Alright, you're nice and calm, Believe.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: As for Believe, she was her usual self. Regarding the venue change, as well—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Normally, running in races with so little rest in between
would easily take a toll on a runner's mentality and motivation...
Yet she shows no sign of that whatsoever.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And... part of me didn't find that
particularly surprising either.
choice_data_list: Let's go. — Let's begin, our work.
Let's go. — Let's begin, our work.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Yes... Let us begin.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The solidness of the foundation built is different.
The sheer amount of training accumulated is different.
The sharpness of the polished precision is different.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Right here, right now, today.
We can deliver our absolute finest work."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It was perhaps natural—or perhaps, inevitable.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: —It's finally starting, Bakushin O-chan.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Yes, yes!!
Fufufu, my heart truly dances with excitement!!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Indeed. What's about to begin is a contest... that pushes one fundamental principle of racing to its absolute limit—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
In other words!!
"Who is the one who can run the fastest"?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Speed! Speed! Speed!!
Only those who pursue pure speed to its absolute limit—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: I'll seize the title of fastest in the autumn, at the very peak!!
